interface Overloaded {convert(value: string): string;}
interface Overloaded {convert(value: number): number;}
class Overloaded {convert(value: any): any {return value;}}
interface Accessed {value: number;}
class Accessed {get value() {return 3;}}
interface Mutable {get value(): number;}
class Mutable {value = 4;}
interface Paired {get value(): number;}
interface Paired {set value(value: number);}
class Paired {value = 5;}
interface StaticSplit {run(): number;}
class StaticSplit {static run = 'static'; run() {return 6;}}
const overloaded = new Overloaded();
const text: string = overloaded.convert('text');
const number: number = overloaded.convert(2);
console.log(text, number, new Accessed().value, new Mutable().value, new Paired().value, StaticSplit.run, new StaticSplit().run());
